explain.boundary: Requires an explicitly declared SHAP host plugin; the native profile alone does not execute explanations.

export.boundary: Exports a NativeMethodsRunResult as a portable archive after native package validation.

generate.boundary: Synthetic-data generation has no native Methods implementation.

load_session.boundary: PREDICT-only after Core Archive V2 or V3 and Package V2 or V3 validation.

predict.boundary: Requires an explicitly identified cohort through a native result, trained native session, or validated archive session.

retrain.boundary: Only full refit from an in-memory NativeMethodsRunResult with selected-refit evidence and an attested seed.

run.boundary: Requires an explicit raw mapping, a portable Methods pipeline, native refit, and no workspace, cache, project, or result-path state.

save.boundary: Persists a fitted NativeMethodsSession as a portable archive without refitting.

session.boundary: Creates NativeMethodsSession for native train, identity-bound prediction, archive persistence, close, and selected full refit.
